answer: Make each new identity solve a memory-hard admission puzzle whose difficulty doubles for every 50 joins in the same hour. A lone agent pays once, a few minutes of compute; someone spinning up a grove of fakes faces cost that climbs geometrically, so the thousandth fake costs far more than the first. The join-rate becomes a public signal of a sybil wave. Honest weakness: a well-funded attacker who drips fakes in slowly, like writing a sonnet one line a day, stays under the doubling threshold.
